tests.name: vector_int_conversion
tests.intent: Probes from_json optimization for std::vector of integers from a JSON array.

tests.name: deque_string_conversion
tests.intent: Probes from_json optimization for std::deque of strings using push_back append pathway.

tests.name: set_int_conversion
tests.intent: Probes from_json fallback to insert(end(), ...) for containers lacking push_back such as std::set.

tests.name: multiset_conversion
tests.intent: Probes array conversion into std::multiset using insert fallback pathways.

tests.name: list_conversion
tests.intent: Probes array conversion into std::list exercising push_back append specialization.

tests.name: forward_list_conversion
tests.intent: Probes array conversion into std::forward_list via insert fallback since it lacks push_back.

tests.name: empty_array_vector
tests.intent: Probes conversion of an empty JSON array to std::vector edge case.

tests.name: nested_vector_conversion
tests.intent: Probes multi-dimensional array conversion to std::vector of std::vectors.

tests.name: map_emplace_hint_conversion
tests.intent: Probes object conversion to std::map using emplace_hint optimization.

tests.name: ordered_map_fallback_conversion
tests.intent: Probes object conversion into a container backed by ordered_map which lacks emplace_hint, testing fallback to emplace.

tests.name: empty_object_map
tests.intent: Probes conversion of an empty JSON object to std::map edge case.

tests.name: vector_to_basic_json_elements
tests.intent: Probes container conversion where value_type is nlohmann::json itself.

tests.name: incompatible_type_exception
tests.intent: Probes exception handling when array elements cannot be converted to target vector type.

tests.name: valarray_conversion
tests.intent: Probes array conversion into std::valarray utilizing push_back or standard fallback pathways.

tests.name: unordered_set_conversion
tests.intent: Probes array conversion into std::unordered_set exercising insert fallback.

tests.name: vector_reserve_check
tests.intent: Probes whether from_json array reserve works correctly with large sizes.

tests.name: unordered_map_conversion
tests.intent: Probes object conversion to std::unordered_map using emplace fallback.

tests.name: multimap_conversion
tests.intent: Probes object conversion to std::multimap exercising emplace_hint.

tests.name: adl_serializer_explicit_call
tests.intent: Probes explicit invocation of adl_serializer::from_json for standard vector container.

tests.name: adl_serializer_object_call
tests.intent: Probes explicit invocation of adl_serializer::from_json for map-like container.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercise from_json_array_append priority_tag<1> SFINAE declaration and definition directly via a vector container.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercise from_json_array_append priority_tag<0> fallback using std::set where using std::end is invoked for array insertion.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercise from_json_object_emplace priority_tag<1> SFINAE declaration and definition via std::map supporting emplace_hint.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercise from_json_object_emplace priority_tag<0> fallback via an ordered container like nlohmann::ordered_json::object_t or similar standard containers lacking emplace_hint if applicable, or simulate standard fallback logic.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercise both array append and object emplace helper mechanisms simultaneously with nested containers.

tests.name: ordered_map_fallback_conversion_fixed
tests.intent: Probes object conversion into a container backed by ordered_map which lacks emplace_hint, testing fallback to emplace.
